title: Coins With the Wrong King
note: After study #202 (Mohamed Bourouissa), prompt MB6: discs fall like slow leaves, flip gold to silver on landing and stack in a neat row; the oldest lifts off when the row fills. Watch first, drag a falling disc to hurry or slow it, drag a stacked disc to toss it back. (Face glyph abstracted to ring vs star-burst, no faces.)

title: The Worried Note
note: After study #203 (Arthur Jafa), prompt AJ1: a single mark plays a nonmetronomic phrase, fast, freeze, replay, slow, freeze, never the same twice; replays leave ghost trails. Watch first, drag grabs the mark but the stutter continues, drag a ghost to erase it.

title: The X-Ray Rowhouse
note: After study #204 (Elissa Blount Moorhead), prompt EM1: five dark house outlines hold wandering light-marks; one house at a time is the bright focus, cycling every 20-40 seconds. Watch first, drag a house to hold its focus, drag a light-mark to move it inside its house.

title: Metaballs
note: Animated metaballs on paper: wandering field sources merge and split as thick black outlines, watch first, drag to add a field source, tap to reseed.

title: Making New Friends
note: Uploaded Procedural IK Cyber-Insect Simulation, as uploaded by Hans: live IK arthropod engine with FABRIK legs, cubic Bezier steps, rotational prediction, panic steps, spring antennae, and a Crimson-Centipede metachronal species.

title: Marble Atlas
note: A procedurally assembled chain reaction across four worlds. Row, climb, swing and roll between connected machines: docking bridges, pressure keys, tipping decks and earned gate releases. Original reactive piano; no final frame.

title: The Last Light
note: A glass ember wakes a forgotten foundry, flowers in a sunlit glasshouse, and constellations beneath a moonlit observatory. One marble, three living chapters, 21 real kinetic acts, endlessly reimagined.

title: Smoke From Nowhere
note: After the Modern Rogue smoke trick: a match strikes low, the flame dies, and the smoke it leaves behind is the piece — curling plumes that bloom, drift, and dissolve, never the same shape twice. Drag to stir the smoke.

title: Five Up, Turn
note: After Salvo Stassi: five balls on a juggler who travels the space, turns full 360s under high throws, kicks balls blind off the foot, and crosses into mills mess.

title: Two Tables, One Marble
note: One red glass marble crosses two tables in a single take: track curves, a rainbow domino line, a blue spinner gate, a seesaw, a gap, and a drop into a star-marked box.

title: Binary
note: A clock told in flipping discs: brass for a lit bit, a ghost ring for a dark one. When the seconds roll over, the flip ripples left through minutes and hours. Tap to hide the digits.

title: The Juggler
note: After Luther Bangert: a juggler in black on a warm stage, five white balls in a true cascade. The hands do the real work — catch wide, scoop low, throw from inside. Watch only.

title: Inkwell
note: Ink dropped in dark water: slow blooms open, curl, and dissolve on a seamless loop. Watch only.

title: Linkwork III
note: Third study after the forged wall sculpture, rebuilt from the chain: crisp rectangular links flowing horizontally, each passing alternately over and under its neighbours. A slow ripple travels the chain; double-tap re-forges it.

title: Linkwork II
note: Second study after the forged wall sculpture: a denser, more tangled cluster of bronze and blackened-steel links. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.

title: Linkwork
note: After the forged wall sculpture: interlocking bronze and blackened-steel links, hand-hammered, each at its own depth. A slow light sweep crosses the metal; double-tap re-forges it.

title: Pinwheel Quilt II
note: Closer to the hand-drawn original: portrait lattice, stronger swirl, wilder warp. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

title: Pinwheel Quilt
note: Ink pinwheels on a warped lattice, after a hand-drawn quilt. A seamless loop; double-tap re-sews it.

title: Perigee
note: One closed harmonograph orbit, one traveler. A seamless loop.

title: Gossamer
note: Verlet silk on a slow wind field. Drag to disturb it.

title: Cipher
note: Code-drawn glyphs orbit in concentric rings at different speeds. Drag to stir; double-tap to reseed.

title: Ember Knot
note: Luminous particles stream along a torus knot on near-black, colored like cooling embers. Drag to orbit; double-tap to reset.

title: Interference
note: Overlapping wave fields drawn as a breathing field of ink dots on paper. Drag to drop a stone; double-tap for new waves.

title: Rhizome
note: A root network that grows, prunes itself, and is reborn in breathing seasons. Drag to bend the growth; double-tap to reseed.

title: Split Tide
note: A recursive subdivision that breathes on a seamless loop. Drag to scrub time.

title: Crosscurrent
note: Two ink currents cross an evolving flow field. Drag to stir, double-tap to reseed.

title: Shear
note: Diagonal bars and wedges on a leaning energy band. Tap to flip.

title: Fission
note: Recursive subdivision grid, splitting and healing. Tap to divide.

title: Murmur
note: Luminous particles coalesce into a glowing ring, hold, and dissolve. A seamless loop.

title: Undertow
note: Luminous particles ride a curl-noise current on near-black, drawing the undertow itself.

title: Afterglow
note: Blazing sunset sky over dark silhouette land, thick palette-knife bands, after Jason Anderson.

title: Swell
note: Thick impasto seascape: foam-white horizon over deep teal water, after Jason Anderson.

title: Concrete
note: Hard-edge geometric shapes on a strict grid, slowly reconfiguring. Tap to rearrange.

title: Impasto
note: Thick palette-knife color blocks in a stained-glass jigsaw, after Jason Anderson.

title: Shimmer
note: Dashed rings interfere until the field seems to move; one ring burns vermilion. Click for another shimmer.

title: Compass
note: Needles lean with a seeded weather of direction; the vertical ones turn rust. Click for another compass.

title: Quarter Turn
note: Coin-flip tiles chain their arcs into paths nobody drew. Click for another quarter turn.

title: Warp
note: A checkerboard bulging under two crossing waves. Click for another warp.

title: Hatch
note: One family of lines, swelling and thinning around a hidden light. Click for another hatch.

title: Raster
note: A strict dot grid sized by two rings arguing. Click for another raster.

title: Well
note: Squares turn a little further as they shrink, down a twisting shaft. Click for another well.

title: Solstice
note: A low vermilion sun, warm rays up and cool rays down. Click for another solstice.

title: Orchard
note: Packed canopies from above, big trees first, fruit in rust. Click for another orchard.

title: Alluvium
note: River mouths spill fans of sediment that overlap and settle over each other. Click for another alluvium.

title: Meridian
note: Meridians bend around slow vortices; the strays burn warmer. Click for another meridian.

title: Silt
note: Layers of earth settle, darken with depth, and slip once along a pale seam. Click for another silt.

title: Undertow
note: Rings bent by a slow current crowd into dark bands. Click for another undertow.

title: Faultline
note: The curves are banned: hard turns, bold faults, sudden slips. Click for another fault.

title: Grainfield
note: Twenty-five thousand dots settle where the current bends. Click for another field.

title: Loom
note: Threads strung on nested rings, pulled taut or left slack; gold warps over the weave. Click for another weaving.

title: Driftlines
note: Hairline currents; tone drawn from the water's speed. Click for another drift.

title: Underdrawing
note: The scaffolding first, then the paint. Watch it build, click to rebuild.

title: Hundred
note: A fixed edition of one hundred prints. Click to walk the edition.

title: Crosscurrent
note: Dark and pale ribbons ride the same current and never touch. Click for a new current.

title: Patch Mountain
note: A mountain built from nothing but patches: directional color strokes on a reserved dark ground, no outlines anywhere.

title: Folded Light
note: One palette, three panels, three moods.

title: Marine Snow
note: The dropped 9055s background polished into its own piece: a quiet water column with slanting light shafts, layered drifting marine snow, and a whisper of distant glow. No creature.

title: Meridian
note: Flowing meridian lines in blue-violet. Drag to stir.

title: Dusk Shore
note: A pixel-art beach from above at dusk, drawn with code. The shoreline breathes, wave bands drift, sun glitter twinkles gold, and tiny figures wait at the foam edge.

title: Misregister
note: One geometric form pulled three times in cyan, magenta and yellow, each plate offset like a misregistered print. The color is the misregistration.

title: Weave
note: Warp and weft threads crossing in plain weave. Each thread alternates over and under at every crossing, like real cloth.

title: Ruled Lines
note: Dense hand-drawn rules in ballpoint blue on paper. A hidden field lifts the lines — the ghost of a circular presence you feel before you see.

title: Tidepool Contours
note: A rock shelf at low tide, read as depth bands. The pools breathe, small crabs work the wet rock, and a click drops a pebble.

title: The Shadow of One Letter
note: A red wireframe solid, hand-drawn, casting a shadow built from one repeated dot. The shadow's edge and density do the drawing. Click for another casting.

title: Eternal Bloom
note: Continuous spawn every 2s: squares expand and rotate at uniform rates, alternating direction.

title: Deliberately Uninteresting
note: After Sol LeWitt. Thousands of identical marks; the composition lives in coverage, never in the mark. Up close it is nothing but handwriting, at distance a curve. Click for another field.

title: Square Fountain
note: Hypnotic loop: squares spawn center, grow and rotate, dissolve at max size.

title: What Is Generative Art
note: The artist writes the rules, the machine rolls the dice, and a family comes out. One branching system, six children, one keeper. Click for another family.

title: Smoke
note: One breath, made visible. A single column of smoke rises, widens, and dissolves into empty paper. Click for another.

title: River Stones
note: A quiet bed of river stones, each water-worn smooth, overlaps deepening honestly. One moss-green stone among the gray. Click for another arrangement.

title: Frost
note: First frost on the pane. Ink-blue crystals creep in from the corners and stop, leaving the middle clear to breathe. Click for another morning.

title: Lunar Strip
note: One lunation in twenty-nine moons, waxing to a gold full moon and waning again, each terminator hand-wobbled. Click for another sky.

title: Crows on a Wire
note: Five on the wire and one just leaving. A small moment, drawn plainly, under a big empty sky. Click for another morning.

title: Wind Field
note: A gust frozen mid-passage through wheat, every blade leaning downwind, the bend swelling where the gust is strongest. One red poppy stands unbent. Click for another field.

title: Slat Light
note: Low sun through a fence, the sun itself offstage. Long soft shadows rake across paper, deepening where they overlap, and one warm band falls where a slat is missing. Click for another evening.

title: Square One
note: One square: its sides unwrap into a single line as it turns, then fold back.

title: Unison
note: Continuous spawn every 2s: all squares rotate the same direction.

title: Sides
note: Dot becomes line, triangle, square, gains sides until a circle, returns to dot.

title: Sides II
note: Dot to circle, skipping sides: readable polygons then a quick rush to round.

title: Halved
note: One random polygon. Draw a line through it and every polygon the line crosses splits in two, in tonal steps. Cut as far as you like.

title: Wire Garden
note: One unbroken wire grown from a pool of fragments, bending toward a wandering lure. The wild joints are marked.

title: Trellis
note: Type any word and watch it grow into a hedge, leaves and blossoms along every letter, the word still readable through the green.

title: Flight Deck
note: Seven fogged depth levels of swirling particle trails, flown through like gates. Click to jump to a fresh system; move the pointer to look around.

title: Personal Weather
note: A field of wind barbs, each with a heading of its own. Your pointer paints weather into the air: fast flicks burn amber, slow drifts stay blue. Move your pointer to stir it.

title: Accumulation
note: Sixteen thousand grains of light dropped one by one until a moon, a ridge, a wave, or a forest gathers out of the dust. Click the piece for a new sky.

title: Subdivide
note: A rectangle keeps splitting until every piece earns a texture: hatching, stipple, rings, the odd flat solid. Only adjacent to Mondrian in method. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Contour Fields
note: Contour lines over imaginary terrain, each drawn a little unsteadily so they read as hand inked. They bunch up where the ground gets steep. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Mai Menochot
note: A rising sun in two passes of ink over still water, the rust pass deliberately misregistered like a slipped letterpress bed. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Three Shapes
note: A tangent chain of circles, squares, and triangles in two inks, construction lines left visible. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Strata Break
note: Concentric rings dissolving from order into chaos, with one red ring. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Interference
note: Wheels of fine lines turn at different speeds, and where they cross, new patterns bloom and dissolve. This one moves. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Oscillons
note: Waveforms drawn the way an oscilloscope draws them, layered in phosphor tones on dark. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Bloom
note: Exact geometry in ink first, then watercolor washes bloom over it and dry where they want. Click the piece for a fresh sheet.

title: Growth
note: A line that follows only local rules grows into folds no hand would draw. This one grows while you watch. Click the piece for a new growth.

title: Murmuration
note: Six hundred particles hold a word that shivers but never lands, until a gust scatters them and they find their letters again. This one moves. Click the piece for a new word.

title: Congregation
note: A living web of three hundred forty seeds that breathes with its own synthesized heartbeat, gathering at every kick. This one moves and makes sound. Click the piece to start it.

title: Tone Mosaic
note: An etching pressed from a thousand voronoi cells, where cell size does all the shading. Click the piece for a new plate.

title: Corridor
note: A quadtree of geometric motifs, camera-projected into an endless corridor. This one moves. Click the piece for a new corridor.

title: Field Notes
note: Wind, recorded the way a field notebook would: inked curves combed across the page, with one red thread running through. Click the piece for a new page.

title: Old Courses
note: An 1881 survey of a river that never flowed, thirteen channels deep. Click the piece for a new survey.

title: Overprint
note: Two ink passes over one quarter-circle grid: indigo first, rust second and a little off register, the way a tired press would lay it down. Click the piece for a new variation.

title: Strata
note: An imaginary terrain sliced like a museum model: translucent elevation layers floating in a dark studio, one warm layer among the ink blues. Drag to look around, click for a new landscape.

title: Tangency
note: A circle-packing study. Discs are placed largest first and grown until each touches a neighbor, so every circle is tangent to something. Rings and arc segments in rust, ochre, and slate on warm paper. Click for a new variation.

title: Lichtenberg
note: A crystal grown from static. Thousands of sparks drift in out of the dark and freeze the instant they touch the tree. Nothing here was drawn, only accreted. Click to grow a new one.

title: Kindling
note: Two fractal flames built from pure density, drifting into each other and back. Bright cores dissolving into smoke. Click for a new burn.

title: Kaleid 99
note: Oscillator bands through a ninety-nine-mirror kaleidoscope, thresholded into hard stripes and printed to near black on paper. One band of color keeps the rest honest. Click for a new variation.

title: Interruptions
note: A dense weave of short ink dashes, each the same length and turned at random, with whole regions erased back to paper. The holes are the drawing. Click for a new variation.

title: Storm Grid
note: Forty-nine nested squares drawn with a plotter's patience, except in two or three cells where the hand slipped. Click the piece for a new plot.

title: Feedback
note: One buffer of noise re-sampled through its own ghost until it settles into flowing grain. The settle is the event. Click the piece to run it again.

title: Still Life
note: Two to four vessels on a low table, drawn flat with long shadows and one accent pot per arrangement. The horizon never lands in the same place twice. Click the piece for a new seating.

title: Hour Hands
note: A clock that repaints itself every minute: three rings for seconds, minutes and hours, each a slow journey between two colors. Click the piece to hold a still.

title: Half-Moon Dots
note: A breathing dotted field crossed by a slowly rotating crescent. Dots that straddle the edge are drawn bisected, so the boundary itself is the subject.

title: What Isn't There
note: A poster printed in reverse: every word exists only as erasure, carved, rubbed and punched out of the ink. Read the gaps.

title: Off Register
note: A playable print-shop instrument: twelve one-gesture motifs on keys A to L, each printed twice with a ghost-ink offset like the sheet slipped. Tap on mobile.

title: Tone Rows
note: A polargraph density study: vertical ticks drawn row by row, length following tone, whites lifting the pen. A rose window in machine handwriting.

title: Orbit Portraits
note: Strange attractors rendered like flame fractals. Every roll picks an orbit; a laciness test hangs the keepers and stamps the duds on the reject wall.

title: Half a Million Grains
note: Half a million grains of sandpaint falling one by one. Nothing is drawn except dots, and the picture emerges. Click the paper for a burst.

title: Own Lines
note: Every stroke is built by hand from shaded triangles, width shaped by pressure, so the line keeps a brush's habits. One study per click: a wave, a heron, bamboo, a grass tuft.

title: Wind Bent
note: Concentric rings sampled through a wind field that pushes in every direction. Click for a fresh gust.

title: Almost Perfect
note: One pen, one line, never lifted: nested squares whose rotation drifts as the path goes in. It draws itself like a plotter. Click for a new hand.

title: Mud Map
note: Three mud zones on the hue wheel, marked dead, and every trapped color drawing its own escape arc to the edge. Click to scatter the colors again.

title: Living Homage
note: After Albers, but the squares never sit still: one slow palette journey, sizes breathing out of phase. Click to mint a fresh journey.

title: Typewriter Weave
note: Struck one character at a time with a shaky hand. Up close it reads as typing; from across the room it reads as cloth.

title: Eye Garden
note: A garden of eye sprouts that watch your pointer go by, pupils widening, then settle back to sleep. Sweep through it.

title: Greedy Squiggle
note: A plotter pen hunts the darkest pixel left on the page, erasing as it goes, lifting to relocate. Mostly one line.

title: Value Ramp Grid
note: Half-square triangles in a deliberate diagonal gradient, light to dark. Nothing else.

title: Bleed Ledger
note: Three hands negotiate on a ruled ledger: hidden pigment, pitted wounds, gravity-drawn streaks. Every trail reads back to its wound.

title: Fifty-Three Divisions
note: The octave divided into 53 commas, brass seams and all. Hover to read each comma in cents.

title: Mark the Seam
note: Twelve pure fifths tiled as kites, the 23.46-cent comma concentrated into one brass wedge.

title: Fusion Threshold
note: Dots accelerate until they stop being dots and become tone. A meter marks the moment.

title: One Series Two Materials
note: One logarithmic series drives both a ribbon's geometry and a striker's rhythm. Same structure, felt twice.

title: Reverse Lookup
note: Drag across a hue spectrum while the piece ranks its palette by simplicity. Vetoes shown struck through.

title: Five Methods
note: One scalar field rebuilt five ways: contour, stipple, hatch, tone cells, drift. Portraits of methods.

title: Face Walk
note: Erv Wilson's hexany as a navigable octahedron. Triads named and sounded in just intonation.

title: Possible Worlds
note: Pascal's triangle as a map of chord worlds. Click a cell to open its diagram.

title: Scale Loom
note: A tuning ladder woven like cloth: fifteen rungs, the pattern re-segmenting live.

title: Hover
note: Marks breathing at the edge of visibility. Your pointer steadies them.

title: Retune
note: Two offset circle grids plus a sheared dot grid. Drag to retune and watch the moire re-resolve.

title: Convergence
note: A tilted crystal of 5-limit harmony. Pulses converge on the root and bloom on arrival.

title: Trough Walk
note: An octave as a washboard of tuning valleys. The probe snaps into troughs; wide ratios eat narrow ones.

title: Held and Shaped
note: Two panels, one material: pulse holds while color shapes, then they trade jobs every 24 seconds.

title: Clang
note: Sixteen agents cycle seven ink marks through a 54-second arc, punctuated by three clangs.

title: Prime Petals
note: A rosette in prime-numbered hues only. Each prime family grows exactly p petals.

title: Tritave Rose
note: Structure repeating at 3x instead of 2x: thirteen rings, marks sized by consonance, slow revolution.

title: Ten Times Exact
note: One recording played ten times byte-identically while the picture turns into notation. Your ears flip before your eyes do.

title: The Exactness Gate
note: Detune the loop by fractions of a semitone and watch song-ness collapse. Exactness as a game.

title: Over Under
note: Seeded Celtic knotwork: strands turn at every wall, crossings alternate over and under, a plaited frame with corner bosses. Click for a fresh knot.

title: Mold and Chisel
note: Fog-sculpture instrument: you place the emitters, the wind does the carving. The last sculpture lingers as a ghost.

title: Eight Minutes
note: This piece only exists during eight-minute fog windows. Between them, a countdown and a tide table of past openings.

title: Seventeen Microns
note: A slider for droplet size against a fixed updraft. Find by eye where float becomes rain.

title: Wrong Octave, Right Key
note: Stretch the octave from 2.0 to 2.6 under a familiar tune. It stays recognizable while the tonic refuses to resolve.

title: Lattice Choir
note: Chords built on a fractional-octave lattice, consonant by construction. Three voices blooming at once.

title: The 3:5:7
note: A brass staircase of thirteen steps to the tritave, lit by odd partials, ending on a 3:5:7 cadence.

title: Master Frequency Only
note: Every sound frozen as a spectral recipe; your only control is one master wheel. Timbre intact, pitch yours.

title: Pairs Only
note: Sixty-four oscillators, spendable in pairs. Rich voices starve their neighbors.

title: Eight Bad Chips
note: Eight synth chips, each with one labeled manufacturing fault. The ensemble of its own failures.

title: Gesture Atlas
note: Draw a stroke and the atlas finds its nearest cousin in the corpus, snapping it under your hand. Endpoints count most.

title: Hue Bingo Canvas
note: Every visit rolls a fresh Hue Bingo palette and lays it down as wobbling colour rings. Coherent by construction.

title: Standing-Wave Hatch
note: A hatch field where a sine wave decides how long each dash gets. Blades of darkness swim through the lines.

title: Family of Blobs
note: The same blob built four ways: harmonic, grown, contoured, implicit. One ink, one plate, the comparison is the picture.

title: Spiral Zap
note: One quiet triadic palette spiralled ten times, calm on the left and feral on the right. The tipping point is visible.

title: Budget Ink
note: A still life shaded on a strict ink budget.

title: Silent Score
note: A polar waveform ring performing a song with no audio.

title: Never Isles
note: A procedural antique nautical chart: radial-noise archipelago engraved as a maritime plate, with rhumb lines, twin compass roses, hachured relief, and recombined place-names. Click for a new chart.

title: Desordres
note: A grid of squares, each disobeying a little; a few burn vermilion. Click for another desordres.

title: Chord Orbits
note: Three rings of points joined every k-th pair by hairlines; one weaves a web, another a slow star. Click for new orbits.

title: Contour Drift
note: Sixty horizontal lines displaced by drifting noise; topographic calm in one ink. Click for a new drift.

title: Night Water
note: Blue-teal motes drift and breathe in dark water; a few wear faint rings. Click for a new tide.

title: Calla Dive
note: A diver in a red cap arcs into a giant calla lily on still water, and the petals close over her. Watch the held breath.

title: Loupe Snow
note: A magnifier rests on a grey-blue field; snowflakes inside its lens grow large, and a stream pours from its rim. Drag the loupe.

title: Outrage
note: Black domino slabs stamped with yellow thumbs-downs fall in a steady column and topple into a pile. Watch the metronome.

title: Fire, Rain
note: One figure wears raindrops, the other flames. Drag them together and their patterns bleed into each other.

title: Moving Toward
note: Two golden grass blades bend toward each other; two ladybugs climb to meet once per loop. Watch for the meeting.

title: The Capsule
note: A woman sits curled inside a giant red-and-white capsule. Drag to tilt it; she slides gently to the low end.

title: Roofwalker
note: A woman stands barefoot on the roof of a doll-scale house under an enormous sky. Watch the clouds drift.

title: The Knot
note: A calm woman stands inside a towering knot of thorny stems and red roses. Drag outward to loosen it, inward to tighten.

title: Chosen Picture
note: A wall of tiny blue cars, one framed bicycle picture, a chair. Drag the frame and the pattern bends away.

title: Moon Reader
note: An astronaut sits on the moon's curve reading a small red book under a bright Earth. Watch a page turn.

title: Yellow Wall
note: A man on a tall ladder, painting a white wall yellow. Drag to paint; the wall keeps every stroke.

title: Blackout
note: A red fist rises from cracked earth under a black skyline, holds, and sinks again. Watch the three acts.

title: One White Sheep
note: One white sheep ringed by black sheep, all facing in. Drag the white one and the ring follows.

title: Morning Abduction
note: A flying saucer beams up the most Italian object in the universe. Watch it bob; drag to nudge the saucer.

title: Expectations
note: A mountain of squeezed orange halves for one finger of juice. Drag to squeeze another; the glass stays nearly empty.

title: Starfisher
note: A child on a dark horizon holds an absurdly long pole, its little net hovering under one bright star. Watch it sway.

title: The Path
note: A two-panel pilgrimage: a lone walker follows a winding path to a distant white church. Drag to move the walker. Tap to reseed the route.

title: Pink Manager
note: A one-panel portrait generator in magenta-skin grammar, tonal first, colorway second. Tap to reseed the pose and colorway. Drag to nudge the head.

title: Summit Loop
note: A golden-hour loop: four mountain bands drift at their own speeds, two tiny hikers stand on the trail, a bird crosses every twenty seconds. Watch.

title: Red Dress
note: A film-noir poster loop: blind light drifts across a deep blue interior, the phone rings once, and the red dress holds. Tap to change the accent.

title: Door Policy
note: One glowing doorway in a dark surround, a warm office inside. Drag the door. Tap to reseed the office.

title: Headcount
note: A suited manager sprouts his own stretched heads like petals. Drag to sprout more. Double-tap to reseed.

title: Quoted
note: His eyes are quotation marks, and every blink swaps the punctuation. Drag the quotes. Tap for a new pair.

title: Sitter's Ghost
note: A desk whose cabriole legs belong to an invisible sitter; the red lamp breathes. Drag to stir the sitter.

title: Multispecies Square
note: A green city square where geese, a piglet, stilt kids and a jogger share one light. Drag to stir the square.

title: Rogue Cover
note: A magazine-cover satire: an ordinary person, an unexpected animal, a giant masthead. Tap to publish a new issue.

title: Pattern Facade
note: A blue swirl-patterned facade under an apricot sun, ghosts passing before it. Drag to pan across the facade.

title: Glitch Pastoral
note: A quiet sepia valley under a rust sun, torn briefly by glitch bands that always heal. Watch for the glitch storms.

title: Mucha Siren
note: An art-nouveau siren whose ribbon hair never stops moving. Tap for a new title word and gown.

title: Belleville Metro
note: A metro station grown into a garden of books, baskets and hanging plants. Tap for a new station.

title: The Big Disc
note: One huge flat disc hangs over a quiet city edge, breathing through three skies. Watch the disc breathe.

title: Solarpunk Haussmann
note: A carless Paris street where ivy grows over Haussmann stone. Drag to plant seeds along your path.

title: Paper Palace
note: A small house on still water, under one giant billowing red cloth. Drag for a breeze.

title: Radiant Still Life
note: A cocktail glass glows amid dashed rays and drifting orbs, watched by one calm eye. Drag to stir the orbs.

title: Jewel Beast
note: A serious blue animal wears one oversized jewel, quite deliberately. Drag to orbit the light; double-tap for a new animal and jewel.

title: Word Shadow
note: A glossy lemon stands before a wall made of its own name. Drag to slide the word; double-tap for a new word and subject.

title: The Gilded Object
note: A calm botanical tarot, one gilded object to a card. Tap to deal the next card; drag to fan the last three.

title: Echo Chamber
note: A hand reaches for its own reflection in a gilt mirror, and the reflection is gently wrong. Drag to move the hand; double-tap to change what the reflection holds.

title: Mountain of Stools
note: Giant stools stand on a rocky summit like mountains, two tiny figures between their legs. Drag to drift the sky.

title: Pomegranate Crown
note: One glossy pomegranate split open on deep indigo, its light forever travelling. Drag to move the light around the fruit; double-tap for another fruit.

title: Abstract Fruits

note: After MyClayCo's Make Shake game: three dice roll a profile, a stack count and a palette, and the study below is built from exactly that roll. Double-tap to shake again and the picture re-rolls with the dice. Double-tap to shake.

title: Click-In Grammar
note: After MyClayCo's Click n Clay Multi Jig: six rainbow-arch cells, each holding one cream insert from a set of four - star, heart, flower, dot. Tap a cell to click a new insert in, double-tap to re-deal the board. Tap a cell, double-tap to re-deal.

title: Puffy
note: After MyClayCo's puffy fridge frames: a small blob form inflating and deflating on a sixteen-second loop, shaded in stepped flat bands with no gradient anywhere. Drag across it to dent it, it springs back. Drag to dent.

title: Double Inset
note: After MyClayCo's Double Ellipse Inset Hoopla: three nested ellipses on near-black, the middle ring scalloped in gold, eight small inset studies around the margin. Drag sideways to slide the middle ring, it eases home on release. Drag to slide the inset.

title: Cutter Stack
note: After MyClayCo's bird cutter stacks: one hand-wobbled bird profile as seven concentric outlines at a one-and-a-half size progression, breathing like a cut being pressed and released on a twenty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Red Triangle
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's degree show: a tall red-lit triangle in a black room, fire churning inside it, dark masks at its base with red-lit eyes, the edge light breathing on a thirty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

title: Raudra Roop
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Raudra Roop: a wrathful glazed mask, crown of skulls and spiral brows, perfectly still while its turquoise glaze flows and pools in the crevices on a sixty-second loop. Watch only. Watch.

title: Spring Convenor
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Spring Convenor: a bamboo mirror on black fabric, covered in red hand-written strips, one carrying her line about Nature as God. Pass a finger near the strips and they lean toward you. Move near the strips to lean them.

title: At Nature's Mercy
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's At Nature's Mercy: a sheer grey curtain in a dark room, one small black-and-white mountain low on the fabric, breathing almost imperceptibly on a forty-second cycle. Watch only. Watch.

title: Cartographies of Cloth
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Cartographies of Cloth: felted contour lines in rust and terracotta with one dark river ribbon running the steepest path through them. Drag to raise the land and the river finds a new way down. Drag to reshape the terrain.

title: Singhay Chosgyal
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Singhay Chosgyal: a white-line wrathful deity in eight-fold symmetry on black, perfectly still, while a red, yellow and green field churns inside its disc. Watch only. Watch.

title: Fear Hope Field
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's two-pole palette: a stepped dye-lot field running diagonally from warning red to wellbeing teal, drifting on slow currents. Touch to resolve the colour where you press; double-tap for a new current. Touch the field; double-tap to reseed.

title: Ways of Protection
note: After Arunima Dazess Wangchuk's Ways of Protection at Old Leh: nine kite forms hung in dark air, triangular windows glowing rose to peach as each kite drifts along her fear-to-hope axis. Drag through them to gust the field. Drag to gust the kites.

title: Moonbeams
note: After Debbie Sharman's moonlight scallops: a dark field of scallop tiles, a cream moon and gold beams in each, alternating by default because she could not choose. Tap a tile to flip it; double-tap to try another arrangement. Tap a tile; double-tap to rearrange.

title: Cheater Quilt
note: After Debbie Sharman's cheater quilt: a 5 by 5 grid of squares pretending to be sewn, plaid, daisy-scallop, starburst and berry stripes, one square always re-sewing itself stroke by stroke. Tap a square to swap its pattern. Tap a square.

title: Swirling Vines
note: After Debbie Sharman's Swirling Vines: six jungle vines trailing down a cream ground, curling and unfurling at their tips, daisies and leaves at their nodes. Drag through them to bend them like wind. Drag to bend the vines.

title: Buffalo Plaid Bee
note: After Debbie Sharman's buffalo plaid bee entry: a bold red and black plaid with one cartoon bee resting on every few checks, wings shivering in turn. Drag across the plaid to lift the bees near your finger. Drag to disturb the bees.

title: Thirty Days, One Palette
note: After Debbie Sharman's 30-day fixed-palette collab: thirty tiles in a 6 by 5 grid, a fox, holly, a wreath and twenty-seven more prompts from her Natural Christmas list, every tile drawn in the same five colours. Tap a tile to see its prompt up close. Tap a tile.

title: Celestial Gingko
note: After Debbie Sharman's Celestial Gingko texture: scalloped rows of gold-line gingko fans on a near-black teal ground, tiny cream flowers at their bases, a shimmer travelling row by row. Tap a fan to shed its gold spores. Tap a fan.

title: Hide and Seek
note: After Debbie Sharman's hide-and-seek wallpaper: a dense daisy and gingko field in greens and teal, seven butterflies hidden in it by colour, worms, snails and spiders planted to mislead. Tap a butterfly when you spot one; double-tap for a fresh field. Tap to seek; double-tap to reseed.

title: Scallop Field
note: After Debbie Sharman's scallop tiles: a full field of scalloped cells, gingko fans and tiny daisies alternating, a slow wave turning the cells over diagonally. Tap a cell to flip its orientation. Tap a cell.

title: Cockatoo Press
note: After Coral Cockatoo's brand bird: a sulphur-crested cockatoo in flat print colours on eucalyptus teal, crest rising and falling, perched on a diagonal branch. Tap for three quick head-bobs. Tap for a head-bob.

title: Crackle Screen
note: After Coral Cockatoo's Marble Crackle screen: a black crackle network printed flat on white, a window onto an endless field, a few cells tinted celadon. Drag to pan the field; tap for a new constellation. Drag to pan; tap to reseed.

title: Three Architectures
note: After Coral Cockatoo's botanical screens: three flower architectures side by side, a banksia cone of spikelets, a bottlebrush of swaying filaments, wattle poms on branching stems. Tap a panel to regrow it in a new variant. Tap a panel.

title: Monoline Study
note: After Coral Cockatoo's monoline drawings: one black line, one weight, drawing a gum blossom, a wattle spray and a banksia cone in turn on white paper, each in a single unbroken-weight hand. Tap to skip to the next specimen. Tap to skip.

title: Three-Part Registration
note: After Coral Cockatoo's three-part screens: one botanical composition printed in vermilion, teal and mustard layers, overlaps mixing where the inks cross. Drag a layer out of registration; double-tap to snap it back. Drag a layer; double-tap to register.

title: Ditzy Field
note: After Coral Cockatoo's ditzy prints: a full field of teeny vermilion gum blossoms on cream paper, a slow swell wave crossing diagonally. Drag to press the motifs up to full size under your finger. Drag to press.

title: Gum Blossom Engine
note: After Coral Cockatoo's Eucalyptus Blossoms screen: six gum blossoms on the dark, caps lifting, gold stamens unfurling in bursts, narrow leaves on woody stems. Tap a blossom to scatter its stamens and watch it regrow. Tap a blossom.

title: Potion Pair
note: After Xanthe Caesia's potion bottles: a raku black bottle and a cream cobalt-swirled bottle, linked by a gold thread between their corks, potion light glowing at each seam. Drag one and its pair follows; tap a cork for a pulse. Drag a bottle; tap a cork.

title: Marble & Transfer
note: After Xanthe Caesia's marbled mugs: brown-and-cream swirled clay with a crisp black silkscreen transfer, wattle, bee, banksia or butterfly, stamped over it. Drag to re-swirl the clay under the print; tap to stamp the next motif. Drag to stir the clay; tap to stamp.

title: Embellish & Cast
note: After Xanthe Caesia's mould ritual: a plain plaster mould, the same form embellished with band, crimped rim, feet and a sprig, and three slip-cast copies in red, grey and black. Tap the middle to draw on a new variant; tap the casts for a new colorway. Tap a stage.

title: Tower of Chance
note: After Xanthe Caesia's wizard towers: a stacked clay tower with glowing slits, backflow smoke at its chimney and mist at its seams, three bone dice at its foot. Drag a die into the roof mouth and it tumbles out the door; tap the chimney for a backflow pulse. Drag a die; tap the chimney.

title: Arcane Inventory
note: After Xanthe Caesia's Arcanum releases: an apothecary shelf of her cauldrons, potion bottles, pumpkin jars, gem boxes and towers, each with its numbered release plate, rarity and usage line, and three field applications below. Tap a vessel to issue the next release. Tap a vessel.

title: Tiny Hut Row
note: After Xanthe Caesia's incense cottages: five tiny cream huts on chicken feet under a night sky, incense smoke curling from every chimney, one hut now and then scratching and settling. Tap a hut to flare its window and pour the smoke. Tap a hut.

title: Scrying Cauldron
note: After Xanthe Caesia's cauldron mugs: a squat dark cauldron with a jagged flame rim and two glowing vents, a tea-light beside it, the black liquid inside holding faint drifting visions. Drag to stir the scrying pool; tap the rim for a gold glint. Drag to stir; tap the rim.

title: Wagtail Loop
note: After Ali Fisher's willy wagtail: a black-and-white wagtail in white linework on deep navy, tail pumping in its real herky-jerky bursts, three, pause, two, over banksia pods and eucalyptus. Watch-only.

title: Flash Sheet Twelve
note: After Ali Fisher's twelve-print series: a flash sheet of twelve motifs, cowboy, cranes, Pharaoh's horses, parrot, panther, snake, croc, wagtail, banksia and mermaid, with hand-lettered labels. Drag cells to mix and match; tap one for its signature move. Drag to rearrange; tap a cell.

title: Tile Trial Grid
note: After Ali Fisher's sgraffito tile trials: twenty handmade crackle-glazed tiles on dark timber, each carved through to the clay with a flower, bird, skull or banksia pod, one corner tile mended with gold. Tap a tile to re-carve it; drag to shift the tabletop. Tap a tile.

title: Swan Quartet
note: After Ali Fisher's swan vase: one swan motif repeated four times around a porcelain vase in cobalt underglaze, reeds between, one swan bowing every nine seconds. Drag to turn the vessel; it settles at the nearest quarter-turn. Drag to rotate.

title: Panther Tatt-Tour
note: After Ali Fisher's vintage panther: a cream ceramic panther covered in underglaze-cobalt tattoo motifs, MUM heart, barbed wire, mermaid, dragon, dice and swallows, with her white dog and cat companions below. Drag to tour the body; tap a motif to watch it inked in three passes. Drag to tour; tap a motif.

title: Babushka Stack
note: After Ali Fisher's babushka dolls: a grumpy cat in a polka-dot scarf over a peony torso and striped pot base. Tap the head to cycle the animal: chihuahua, croc, mermaid, each with its own scarf. Tap the head.

title: Honeyeater Perch
note: After Ali Fisher's native-bird flash: a New Holland Honeyeater in white linework on deep navy, bottlebrush at the branch tip, a small silvereye study below, one petal falling each loop. Watch-only.

title: Never Clock Off Wall
note: After Ruby Waters' NEVER CLOCK OFF show: five creature-clocks on a gallery wall, puffer, octopus, tengu, boar and kokeshi-face, all telling real time with black hands, brass name plates below. Tap a clock and it jumps down and wakes. Tap a clock.

title: Flash Drop
note: After Ruby Waters' flash sheets: nine creature motifs on cream, inked live one cell every four seconds: outline, flat colour flood, detail pass, holding as a finished sheet before washing back to bare outlines. Watch-only.

title: Okame Mask Field
note: After Ruby Waters' okame masks: eleven round moon faces with black bobs and high blush drifting at three depths over faint giant chrysanthemums, bobbing on staggered phases, one slow blink every eight seconds. Watch-only.

title: Squiggle and Dot
note: After Ruby Waters' two-tone pattern split: cadmium yellow and black squiggles above a hard wavy seam, white and orange dots below, the seam breathing and the dots pulsing in traveling waves. Drag to push the seam; it springs back. Drag to push the seam.

title: Wave Ground
note: After Ruby Waters' onna-musha painting: a warrior in vermilion and mint rides a still folk horse while the banded cobalt wave ground scrolls beneath, near rows faster than far. Watch-only.

title: Dala Engine
note: After Ruby Waters' Dala horse: a blocky painted toy horse, polka-dot fields and an S-curve flourish, its raffia tail a hundred swaying strands. Drag through the tail to part it; tap the saddle medallion to ripple its spots. Drag the tail, tap the medallion.

title: Kokeshi Stack
note: After Ruby Waters' kokeshi dolls: a moon-face doll on a cone body of stacked pattern bands, stripes, lotus, chrysanthemum and waves, a tiny Mt Fuji at its base breathing small clouds, swaying like a weeble. Watch-only.

title: Kawaii Vessels Grid
note: After Ruby Waters' Kawaii Vessels print: a 4x3 flash sheet of creature-vessels, planters, pots, a cat-lamp and an octopus-pot, blinking and swaying in slow cascade, each cell alive on its own phase. Watch-only.

title: Puffer Time
note: After Ruby Waters' puffer clock: a spiky tattoo-flash puffer, squiggle over dots, googly eyes tracking you, keeping real time from its brass centre. Drag a spike to wobble it; tap to puff. Drag to wobble, tap to puff.

title: Test Tiles
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's thousands of glaze test tiles: a 4x5 museum grid of special-effects glazes, each tile running its own micro-loop. Drag to swirl the tiles you cross; double-tap reseeds the grid. Drag to swirl, double-tap to re-tile.

title: Gold Seam
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's kintsugi repair philosophy: a dark vessel breaks along glowing seams and reassembles, each cycle leaving its gold lines behind. Tap to break it now; double-tap freezes the break. Tap to break, double-tap to hold the break.

title: Never Clock Off
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's NEVER CLOCK OFF timepiece (with Ruby Waters): a vessel fused with a clock face, a small fish swimming its slow orbit while the hands keep real time. Watch-only.

title: Wobble Mug
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's classic Hound wobble mug: a squat black-clay mug with a deep radial wobble in its wall and a smooth satin inside. Drag to twist the wobble; double-tap reseeds it. Drag to twist, double-tap to re-throw.

title: Belly Crack
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's sodium-silicate crackle: a pale slip-white vessel whose geometric fracture network grows as its belly slowly swells, then holds as the belly relaxes. Tap to re-seed the fractures; double-tap holds the swell. Tap to re-seed, double-tap to hold.

title: Crater and Gloop
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's crater and gloop glazes: a glossy black skin pocked with golden crater rings, silver-grey streaks melting down between them. Tap to replant the constellation; double-tap regrows the silver. Tap to replant, double-tap to regrow.

title: Slow Dissolve
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's Slow Dissolve: a tall dark vessel with a green-blue crackled glaze pouring from the shoulder in long drips toward a pale stone base. Drag to smear new drips downward; double-tap reseeds the pour. Drag to smear, double-tap to re-pour.

title: Salt Worn
note: After Sophia Golovanevskaya's salt-eroded porcelain: a cream vessel whose lower half is pitted matte bone, its upper half holding a smooth teal glaze, a ragged shoreline between them where the tide breathes and slowly recedes, barnacles clinging along the line. Watch-only.

title: Basin Rings
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's top-down basin: concentric glaze rings, an ochre rim, a celadon ring and a dark-red centre pool under a fine crackle, turning with glacial slowness, each ring at its own pace while the crackle holds still. Watch-only.

title: Terracotta Speckle
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's terracotta range: a burnt-orange field of raw clay, dense with cream and dark speckle. Drag to stir the speckle into swirls; let go and it settles back to stillness. Drag to stir.

title: Calabash
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's harvest calabash: a squat pot banded in earthy brown and sea-green, breathing very slowly while its bands slide like a tide and fine speckle drifts up its surface. Watch-only.

title: Apprentice
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's father-daughter lineage: a master vessel at the left and a family of smaller pots to its right, each child inheriting the profile with a slight mutation of form and colour. Tap and one more generation grows. Tap to grow a generation.

title: Smoke Resist
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's wax-resist raku firing: a cream vessel on near-black, smoke streaming across it and laying soot everywhere except where you have painted wax. Drag to paint resist and keep those places cream; double-tap clears the soot and turns the smoke. Drag to paint, double-tap to re-fire.

title: Target
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's hand-painted medallions: a wobbly spiral target in terracotta, cream and cobalt on a crackled cream ground, green bleeding in at the rim, drawn stroke by stroke, ring by ring, the ochre spiral last. Watch-only.

title: Crackle
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's crackle veil: a deep cobalt field grows a black craquelure network, each fresh crack carrying a faint hot edge out of the kiln before it cools matte. Drag across it for thermal shock and new cracks branch from your path; double-tap to re-glaze. Drag to crack, double-tap to reseed.

title: Zigongo Bands
note: After Njalikwa Chongwe's banded vessels: a pot in side profile stacked with flat bands of coral, cobalt and emerald divided by black zigzag lines, one cream band in the stack. The bands rise slowly as if the vessel is being pulled from clay while its belly breathes. Watch-only.

title: Negative Space
note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's line that it is not the vessel itself which is valued, but the negative space it holds: a ring of tall vessels stands near-silhouette in a dark room while a single slow light orbits, and the gaps and hollow mouths flare and dim in turn. The subject is the holes, not the pots. Watch-only.

title: Crackle
note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's naked raku: dark ceramic spheres and ovoids on a pale ground, each wrapped in its own crackle network in tan veining, dense where it cooled fast, sparse where it cooled slow. Tap to re-fire the kiln and every network re-forms. Tap to re-fire.

title: Rock That Was Once Rock
note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's rock-formation stoneware: craggy strata-banded vessels that read as both geology and pot, clay being rock ground down and given back its shape. Tap to turn the rock over: the silhouettes stay, the strata, iron seams and lichen re-form on another face. Tap to re-stratify.

title: The Clouds That Kept Us Grounded
note: After her Leh sky forms: heavy burnished stoneware clouds rest low over a dark Ladakhi ground, from days of staring at the sky and hoping the clouds don't clear. They drift almost imperceptibly while the low sun breathes across their surfaces. No interaction: stillness is the point. Watch-only.

title: Interlock
note: After her interlocking raku sculpture: two matte ceramic forms holding each other on a warm empty ground, one black with tan crackle veining, one warm stoneware. Drag to pull the pair apart along their embrace; release and they settle back together, slow and soft, the veining denser where they meet. Drag to separate.

title: Bedforms
note: After Bedforms: a sediment field of ripples in warm clay browns, geology reading as skin, with a few vessel silhouettes half buried at the edges. Drag through it and the ripples dent like wet clay under a hand, relaxing slowly and never quite forgetting the touch. Drag to press the clay.

title: Nduku
note: After her Bedforms wall sculpture Nduku: ceramic shards, matte black spheres and curved brown panels hang in a wide rhythm on a white gallery wall, one shield fragment veined in tan raku. Drag through them and they swing on invisible mounts, shadows swinging with them, settling slowly back to stillness. Drag to disturb.

title: Living Vessels
note: After Shupiwe Chongwe's Vessel at Likir: dozens of unfired clay vessels on stones in a dusty field under a low stone wall, each holding a hidden seed. Over about a minute the vessels weather, cracks spreading, surfaces darkening, and green shoots rise from the mouths. The piece never resets: time is the artist. Watch-only.

title: What Melts Does Not Stay
note: His Fremantle thesis in one frame: a glacial blue field at the top, a band of nambu stripes across the middle, sand below. Luminous particles leave the glacier edge, travel the full height along a gentle curve, and settle into white salt rings on the sand that expand, fade and renew. A glacier carries history; what melts in the Himalayas doesn't stay there. Watch-only.

title: Factory Summit
note: His industrialization piece: a pale blue grey mountain with a dense little factory straddling its highest peak, tan blocks, towers, chimneys. Over forty seconds the smoke thickens and the factory creeps a little further across the ridge, then recedes and the peak is clean again. The mountain endures: the warning, not the catastrophe. Watch-only.

title: Winter Warrior
note: His 2022 bronze, monumental and still: a lone winter figure in heavy clothes and a big rounded fur hat, hands clasped, standing frontal on rough rock under a plain overcast sky. Almost nothing moves: a slow breathing rise and fall, and now and then a small wisp of breath fog. No pedestal, no turntable. Watch-only.

title: Chadar Balance
note: His chadar trek scrap porter: a small laden figure of rusted parts, glowing red headlamp, chain icicles dangling from the torso, jerrycan on its back, balanced high on tilted diamond plates of thin ice. The whole group sways a degree and a half on a twenty five second loop, chains swinging out of phase. A held breath. It never falls. Watch-only.

title: River Shadow
note: Tsepel's Henasku canyon: layered rock strata left and right, and through the gorge floor the pale winding shadow of a river that no longer flows. The ghost channel breathes on a thirty second loop, widening, narrowing to a thread, widening again: a memory of flow, not water. Dust motes drift in the one warm light. No blue anywhere: it is a shadow, not a stream. Watch-only.

title: Path of Hope
note: The Path of Hope as the 1 by 4 metre chiffon banner reads: a winding trail of footprints in snow, heavy boots and light steps side by side, entering large in the foreground and curving up between dark rocky walls to distant blue peaks. The trail is a record, not an event: only a slow snowfall and a faint breathing of light move, over forty seconds. Watch-only.

title: Nambu Tide
note: Where Mountains Meet the Sea: five to seven hand woven nambu wool cones, off white with bold black stripes, hang over a warm sand floor dotted with white salt mounds. The cones sway almost imperceptibly, breathing tidal, and their shadows ripple outward across the sand in slow concentric rings. Shadow is the second artwork. Watch-only.

title: Glacier's Retreat
note: Tsepel's Disko Valley land work: a lime white hillside scored with a branching maze of low blue walls and rust iron rods, marking where the Parkachik and Drang Drung glaciers used to be. Blue is former ice; white is exposed earth. Over thirty five seconds the blue thins and retreats upslope, then the hillside restores itself. The work dismantles and reimagines itself. Watch-only.

title: Silhouette Signal
note: His Day 10 silhouette study: a chunky black mech mirrored top and bottom on dark teal, cyan lights dotted along its armour seams. The lights chase slowly along the seams; the reflection below runs the same chase a third of a second behind. No other colour exists here. Watch-only.

title: David from Ladakh
note: His joke, kept straight: a grey clay David bust with curly hair wearing a tall, slightly worn top hat, turning slowly on black, one full turn every twenty four seconds, warm rim light on the clay. Tap to reseed: a new hat tilt and a fresh variation in the curls.

title: Yeti Hunter
note: His first ZBrush sculpt, kept flat: an elderly yeti hunter's bust on black, long white beard, tattooed torso, dark robe, red sash and headwear, lit by one deep red spotlight that slowly arcs so the tattooed planes catch the light in sequence. Dust motes hang in the beam. Watch-only.

title: Hard Surface Mech
note: His Day 7 hard surface study: a chunky low poly mech with big yellow leg armour, green knee pads and pink orange piston feet, standing on a flat green plane under a dark sky, lit like a film still. It idles, plates shifting a few pixels, accents breathing. Drag to orbit it; the yaw carries inertia and settles.

title: Chaos Poster
note: A violet graphic poster in his bomb poster template: one dome fragment emblematic at centre, churning smoke shapes behind it, museum label typography below, the single accent character for chaos at top right, one caption line at the bottom. One hue family only, purple on purple. Watch-only.

title: Dandelion Ball
note: A dandelion seed head of pastel strands, blue, white and pink, on near black, a thin stem below. It sways gently and sheds the odd seed upward. Drag across it to shake: a burst of seeds lets go and drifts off, and the ball regrows its full head over ten seconds.

title: Day Five
note: Chospel's Day 5, presented as his learning log presents it: a lone figure on a rocky ridge under a huge looming dome, teal water glow everywhere, a hard red light raking the rocks from the left. The atmosphere breathes on a twenty second loop, light shafts drifting, the glow pulsing. The caption is his: Day 5. Watch-only.

title: Lost Glacier
note: A digital horizon after A Sky for Henasku: pale sky, a white glacier band, dark rock, nothing else. Over thirty seconds the glacier thins and recedes upward, a meditation on a lost glacier, then restores. The sky band drifts almost imperceptibly. No objects, no text. Watch-only.

title: Sets of Three
note: A climbable blue scaffold stepping up a Ladakhi hillside in sets of three, each trio smaller than the last, deep blue against pale rock. The topmost trio sways gently in the wind. Drag across it and the poles bend aside on their springs and settle back; the system is the toy. Double tap reseeds the trio layout.

title: Mineral Spirits
note: A golden scaffold standing in a dark abandoned hotel lobby in Astoria, four bays wide and rising past the top of the frame, dust hanging in diagonal light shafts from the upper right. The shafts drift on a thirty five second loop, the gold breathes, forty dust motes wander. After Bawa's 2016 installation in the vacant Astor Hotel. Watch-only.

title: Secretariat Study
note: A hard edge abstraction of the Chandigarh Secretariat in graphite on paper: stacked slabs and a brise soleil grid, every line admirably straight but hand drawn, wobbling one or two percent off true, with a pale embossed ghost of the same geometry offset beside it. Strictly monochrome. Tap to reseed a new abstraction of the same building grammar.

title: Scaffold Configuration No. 7
note: Five to seven little nickel steel scaffold maquettes clustered in a black room, lit from one side, throwing webs of interlacing shadow across all four walls. The light drifts on a forty second loop and the shadow webs breathe apart and together; the maquettes themselves never move. You feel Gulliver sized looking down at them. Watch-only.

title: The Collapse
note: A pink scaffold fallen in a white salt desert, poles splayed, one corner still upright. Over forty five seconds it puts itself back together, bay by bay with a little overshoot wobble, stands whole for five seconds, then drops again in three, staggered, and rests. Resilience and resurrection in its bones. No debris, no drama. Watch-only.

title: Stoically Itself
note: A white scaffold in a white room, drawn so pale it nearly dissolves into the walls. The real subject is its shadows: long grey webs cast across the floor and walls by one orbiting stage light, stretching, crossing and reforming over thirty seconds while the structure itself never moves, and fading a touch more transparent as its shadows lengthen. Watch-only.

title: Cocktail at Midnight
note: One hot pink scaffold bay in a dark storefront window at midnight, the exact pink of her title, #FF0080. A slow wave of brightness travels across the bays over fifteen seconds, full pink to dim and back, while the window glass throws faint vertical reflection streaks below. Flat colour, no neon glow, no signage. Watch-only.

title: Blue Punch
note: A blue scaffold crushed into a V shaped gorge in Ladakh: packed so dense the poles interpenetrate and the top mass bulges like it is about to burp, the log fills stacked in threes, smaller as they climb. The whole mass breathes on a twenty second loop, tightening and brightening, then relaxing dim. Dust motes drift. A blue punch that pops out of the landscape. Watch-only.

title: Deluxe Unit
note: Woodfill's rolling deluxe unit: a plywood tower on casters, speaker cones below, tiny green and red status LEDs, and a sign panel up top rotating ninety degrees every eight seconds through its glyphs, circle, triangle, bar, X. Each glyph change kicks the speaker cones with a visible pulse. The whole unit rolls a slow small circle on the dark floor, casters swivelling with the direction. Silent, despite the speakers. Watch-only.

title: Seeing the Night Bluely
note: Yesterday's sky, broadcast tonight: a wide horizon band of forty colour strata sampled from one day's arc, dawn amber through noon pale to dusk violet, drifting almost imperceptibly over a dark field, one thin registration line marking the tower. A full day plays over six minutes, holds night for thirty seconds, then restarts with different weather. Watch-only.

title: Training Models
note: A workshop shelf of boxy wood forms, birch, white and grey with exactly one green accent box, alive in stop motion: every half second they snap to neighbouring grid cells with a two pixel handmade jitter, rotations only ever in fifteen degree steps. No tweening, no easing. Drag may nudge one off its cell; on release it re-enters the walk.

title: Ladder Ladder
note: A ladder built out of small ladders: every rung a tiny ladder, every rail a stack of them, clamped and bolted at every joint, provisional as a workshop thought. Drag any mini ladder and it pulls out of the assembly; let go and it springs home, the whole rig wobbling with the disturbance before it settles back into itself.

title: Honest Signals
note: Ninety six semaphore flags on thin poles, white and signal red, each holding one of four orientations. A seeded message propagates through the field as waves of flips; then noise creeps in, spurious flips rising until the pattern is unreadable, until a call and response sweep reasserts the honest signal and the noise floor resets. Tap reseeds the message.

title: Shadows Variable
note: Flat wood tone panels, bars, triangles, one disc, one safety orange accent, drifting and turning slowly on a pale wall. Two fixed lamps off frame throw long hard shadows to the lower right; the shadows lag a beat and a half behind the panels and stretch as a panel nears its lamp. The shadows are the second artwork. The lamps never move; the world does. Watch-only.

title: Cocktail Party
note: Five bare mechanisms sharing a dark stage: a pendulum bar, a bulb bouncing on its cord, a wheel rolling a circular track, a whirling fan vane, a metronome arm, mounts and wires all exposed. Each keeps its own period, seven, eleven, thirteen, seventeen, twenty three seconds, so every few minutes they near align for one beat, acknowledge each other, and drift apart again. A cocktail party for electronic nerds. Watch-only.

title: Pulse
note: Woodfill's parking garage pulse: nine rows of sixty square lamp dots across near black, rows offset half a dot so the chase drifts diagonal. Brightness travels in long packets, rows lighting in sequence, holding, releasing; sometimes two packets cross and interfere instead of cancelling. Flat light only: these are on and off devices, no glow, no atmosphere. Watch-only.

title: Slow Mathematics
note: The quietest Kluber: thin black and light blue stripes on paper, split two fifths to three, one solid black band cutting across the bottom third. A single red line redraws itself continuously along the stripe boundaries, one edge at a time, a full pass every seventy five seconds. Tap to reseed its path; the page never reloads, the line just starts a new proof.

title: Radio Free Santa Fe
note: Lime and cyan stripes full bleed, warm yellow green along the top and bottom edges, and six blocks of orange and violet interrupting the flow, three left, three right. Each block breathes on its own prime period clock, twenty three, thirty one, forty seven, fifty nine seconds, a slow inhale and exhale of opacity, never a blink. No antennas, no waves: the title is the only nod to radio. Watch-only.

title: Parsing the Lingo
note: The one Kluber you may touch: wide turquoise and chartreuse bands around a big central rectangle of ninety fine blue and green lines on deep blue, an optical field like data made visible. Drag across it and the lines scramble locally under your finger, then spring back to order over about four seconds. At rest a faint data shimmer runs through them. The piece heals itself.

title: Burning Year
note: A square relief of twenty four by twenty four cells, each split into four triangles, coloured in hard stepped bands from neon green through yellow and orange to deep red on near black, after the 3D printed Burning Year. The relief never changes shape; only the light moves, a slow sun orbiting over ninety seconds, shading each facet and dragging a specular streak across. Watch-only.

title: Melt Together
note: Orange, yellow and teal lines above and below a central teal green band filled with fragmented orange geometry, after Friday I'm in Love. One slow diagonal luminance wave crosses every forty seconds, desynced from the painted edges, so band edges seem to shift colour while the paint never moves. You cannot tell which colours are painted and which are projected. That is the piece. Watch-only.

title: Never the Same Twice
note: Teal, dark teal and chartreuse stripes hold perfectly still while four independent light layers play over them: a warm wash drifting sideways, a cool wash rising and sinking, a narrow travelling light rectangle, a slow scanline flicker. Their periods are primes, thirty seven, fifty three, sixty one, eighty nine seconds, so the whole state effectively never repeats. The painting never moves. Watch-only.

title: Split Infinitives
note: Three densities of orange on yellow: sixty four tight dark orange lines at left, twenty eight looser stripes at centre, sixty four at right, a deep orange band bisecting the middle. Over the paint, one additive wash of white gold light drifts left and right on two incommensurable periods, forty seven and seventy one seconds, so the composite never repeats in a sitting. Watch-only.

title: Crash Stripes
note: Kluber's origin crash, frozen: thin horizontal bands of lime and charcoal on near white, heights set by a seeded sequence, a column of narrower stripes at the far left. One band glitches: it stutters, doubles, flashes cyan for a beat, then settles, re-firing every nine to fourteen seconds on its own schedule, never on a click. Flat colour only, no gradients, no error dialogs. Watch-only.

title: Resonance Field
note: Three or four ripple centres drift out of phase on near black ground, their concentric rings crossing into moire, small warm glyphs orbiting each centre like buffers of found sound made visible. It is her chance sound drawn instead of heard: a pure watch piece with no interaction at all.

title: Messy Desk
note: A messy desk on kraft paper: note cards, printout fragments, arrows, coffee rings, a highlighter yellow sticky or two, all deliberate clutter. A wandering reader cursor underlines fragments and ties the last few together with red thread, then redraws its thinking. Drag the fragments and they snap back elastically, unless the thread holds them.

title: Blue Atlas Scroll
note: A long scroll of thin Prussian blue line drawings on paper white: coastline contours, a railway with its stations, a small bird with a suitcase, equations and text fragments that dissolve as they pass. Nothing filled, nothing shaded. It drifts slowly left, seamlessly; drag to scrub through the atlas yourself.

title: Generator Fugue
note: McTavish's swarm made visible as a pipeline: a cyan particle stream flows left to right through four small labelled stations, generate, filter, transform, render. The filter culls and leaves magenta residue; the transformer turns the survivors; the renderer deposits warm yellow marks that accumulate into a drawing on the right, fading over ninety seconds. Drag across the stream to inject a burst.

title: Telegraph
note: A ghost typist at a telegraph: short strange phrases in phosphor amber, typed character by character with an irregular rhythm, held a moment, then each letter jitters and crumbles into falling dots, dissolving like sand. Between phrases, Morse like pulses blink dim green along the bottom edge. Tap to reseed the phrase source.

title: Chance Cloud
note: A pointillist field of ink dots on warm gray paper, each holding a little energy, sharing it with its neighbours, fading when it runs dry. Clusters bloom where energy concentrates and dissolve where it drains; a few rust dots mark the high energy survivors. Nothing is random static: it is an ecology of chance, converging and going extinct on a thirty second breath.

title: Stitched Maps
note: A quilting machine stitching maps on muslin: precise indigo contour lines following a noise field, drawn on stitch by dashed stitch from left to right, and over them a hand layer in madder, looser, jittered, knotting where it crosses. When the map completes it holds, then a new one begins. The machine never stops.

title: Machine Quartet
note: Four machines drawing on warm paper, each by its own rule: a jittered random walk, a Lissajous, a curl noise drift, a decaying orbit, pens never lifting, old ink fading over a minute. Every twenty seconds a convergence pulls all four to one invisible point and the lines braid for five seconds before scattering back to their rules. Drag near a thread and it follows your hand for three seconds.

title: If/Then
note: Two identical little machines with camera eyes, courting across the dark on a strict if then grammar: seek, detect, a thin green box snapping round the partner labelled mate with a climbing confidence, approach, almost touch at ninety seven percent, then a quick retreat, and seeking again. Each courtship makes the next approach a little bolder. Drag one aside and it reorients and resumes.

title: Antipode
note: A pink foam relief of the place on earth exactly opposite this gallery, clouds and ocean swells carved as miniature topography under raking light, two older carvings leaning beside it. It is still, as carvings are. Every fifty seconds a new antipode is carved and the old one joins the stack. Drag across it and your finger presses the foam, leaving a deeper trail that stays on that carving. Double tap to carve a new one now.

title: Night Pilot
note: A plant is the pilot: two slow noise channels from its leaves steer a drone through the night, and its amber light draws a long exposure trail that fades over twenty five seconds, the drawing always half dissolved. When the trail is gone the drone hovers, then a new plant takes over. Double tap for a new plant; drag near the drone to nudge it off course for a moment.

title: Debris Sun
note: Fifty twigs in the dark, all leaning exactly the same way, tracking the oldest piece of space debris currently above the horizon from a small catalog of 1958 to 1972 objects, its position a tiny dim amber point high in the frame. When it sets, every twig lowers to rest and waits for the next oldest to rise. Double tap to advance.

title: Sky Scroll
note: A ballpoint plotter drawing the sky on warm paper: hatch strokes dense where the clouds are thick, dissolving to bare paper at the edges, the little red nib working back and forth in bands for about twenty five seconds a drawing. Then the scroll advances, the finished sky slides into the stack below, and a new sky begins. Double tap to advance early.

title: Fly Brain
note: On warm paper, a glass sphere of about a hundred houseflies, and beside it a sheet where a small red carriage carves what the flies do: a lone fly draws a hairline, a dense cluster gouges thick, the carriage following the swarm's centroid. After three minutes the sheet scrolls away intact and a fresh one starts. Double tap inside the sphere for new flies and a new sheet.

title: Station 46246
note: A lattice of wooden rods on near invisible threads, rippling as one wave passes through it: a simulated NOAA buoy reports height and period, and each rod answers the same wave a fraction later than its neighbour. Every minute the sea state changes; about every three minutes the buoy goes missing for five seconds and the lattice settles, waiting. Tap to call the next sea state early.

title: Tele-Present
note: A field of about one hundred twenty six dried stalks, all leaning the same way at the same moment, because none of them is deciding: a single remote wind sensor drives them all, its little mechanism twitching in the corner a beat before the field answers. The weather changes every minute or so. Drag to throw a local gust through them.

title: In Need of Love
note: A small hunched creature of worn cloth, one limb too long, eyes slightly mismatched, alone in a large dark field. It flinches. Fast hands make it recoil and hunch tighter; a slow, gentle drag across its back soothes it, warmth blooming through its fabric, until at full trust it uncurls, leans into the touch, and does its one soft jiggle of contentment. Double tap for another.

title: Jiggle Choir
note: Five small patchwork creatures, each running the toy verbs on its own clock: jiggle, shuffle, squeak, recoil, desynchronized like a choir warming up. Every so often they all squeak at once. Their tempo follows the time of day, lively at midday, drowsy at night. Tap one for a solo; drag through them to scatter the choir.

title: Message Wall
note: Three amber tardigrade vessels resting under a reef wall of glowing marks. Tap anywhere to contribute: your mark blooms and drifts up into the wall, and the nearest vessel pulses, its glow shifting toward your hue. The wall remembers the whole session. Double tap clears it for the next thousand messages.

title: Twisted Landscape
note: A dreamscape relief of seven twisted aluminum sheets: cave hollow, flying ridge, river cut, grass in fine strokes, readable from several viewpoints at once. Drag sideways to fan the layers apart like a deck; drag down to pinch them together. Release and it settles into a new distortion, never the original. Double tap for another landscape.

title: Instant Life
note: Sammy at sixteen feet: a monumental brine shrimp that does not fit the frame, translucent membrane over a segmented body, swimming upside down as brine shrimp do. The view drifts slowly along its length, eleven leg pairs paddling in travelling waves; drag to slide the window toward the head or the tail.

title: Tun State
note: A tardigrade in muted amber, ambling on clawed legs. Leave it alone for twenty seconds and it presses pause: legs fold, body wrinkles and collapses into the dark tun, a dehydrated blob that pulses faintly, still alive, waiting. Tap and it rehydrates, plumps back to amber and walks again.

title: Heat Gun
note: A brine shrimp of clear heat welded plastic, its membrane stretched over a darker inner body you can see through the skin, weld seams bright along every edge. It drifts and paddles slowly. Drag anywhere and your finger is the heat gun: the membrane bulges toward it, softened, then cools back to shape over eight seconds. Double tap for a different creature.

title: Artificial Spirit
note: A creature sewn together from discards: worn fabric swatches, a leather patch, glass bead eyes, one arm that clearly belonged to a different toy. It lives by four toy verbs, jiggle, shuffle, squeak, recoil, cycling them in random order. Drag on it and it recoils from your hand; drag gently near it and it shuffles closer.

title: Worm Friends' Chorus
note: Maude's worm friends on their own stage: nine dim green worms in a loose field, each holding a phrase of up to eight notes. Tap a worm to feed it notes; it loops them back at its own tempo, every replayed note an expanding ripple, all nine drifting in and out of phase. Double tap clears a voice. One worm is a stranger and plays gold.

title: Panther Prowl
note: A Florida panther that assembles itself from forty numbered steel plates, each landing with a white blue weld flash, stands in a prowl with gold heat accents on its flanks, then comes apart again. Drag while it stands and its head tracks your finger.

title: Crush
note: A twelve foot man built from bike parts, chainring hips, spoke ribs, chain spine, whose open torso is a recycling hopper. Tap to toss a can into him; every fifth can triggers the crush, torso folding in, cans bursting to flecks. Drag his arm to aim the next throw.

title: Peroxide
note: A plasma cut steel carp tail and a peroxide brush. Drag the brush across the tail and rust blooms along your stroke, spreading and darkening over the next minute, bloom to mature rust to deep umber. Double tap for a fresh tail, the next trophy.

title: Brake-Light Wings
note: A monarch whose wings are a mosaic of domed brake light red and turn signal amber panels over a steel vein frame. She beats her wings slowly; light drifts across the domes; then hail cracks three panels, and they are repaired one by one, re glossed. Drag a wing tip to tilt her.

title: Bike-Chain Fur
note: Sassy the Sasquatch, eleven feet of her, her fur woven from thousands of interlocking bike chain links combed over her body. Drag across her to part the fur; it ripples like chainmail and settles back heavy. Every forty five seconds the scene darkens, and at full dark her blue eyes bloom.

title: Mock Back
note: Maude, a bird of hot pink, teal and yellow flat blocks with an aluminum belly, perched over five little worm stations. Tap a worm to speak; she mocks your tap pattern back transformed, then answers with a stranger's older phrase from her memory. Double tap her for a scrambled greatest hits.

title: FRESH FISH CRATE
note: A fish built from fourteen stacked steel layers, gold at the front where the heat took it, rust red at the fins, swimming as a topographic contour map; it arrives in a stenciled wooden crate whose lid swings away. Drag to pull the layers apart into their contour set; double tap for a different fish.

title: Push a Hundred Times
note: One big steel and rubber button in the dark, with a single ring of light. It does nothing until you push it, and then everything: ripples, then arcs of light bouncing off the edges of the world, then a full cascade, escalating with every press and never punishing a masher. Leave it alone and it presses itself, demonstrating.

title: Numbered Sections
note: A dancing boar arrives unfinished, as twelve numbered steel sections scattered around its silhouette. Drag each section home; only its own slot accepts it, with a soft clunk flash. Assemble all twelve and the boar rears up and dances for twenty seconds. Double tap to scatter it again.

title: Smash Frame
note: A water balloon, a powder egg and a piece of fruit hang in a row in a dark studio. Tap one and the bat swings; at the instant of impact time dilates to near stop while thin white lines diagram the collision, force vectors, shock rings, fracture maps, then time releases and the mess falls. Drag to aim.

title: Forty-Five Foot Worm
note: A forty five foot ferrocement worm crawling in place across warm paper, forty segments rippling head to tail, every tenth painted weathered red. Drag along its body to conduct the peristalsis; tap a red segment and it tucks, shy, then relaxes.

title: Mock Back
